reviewer_note: Read only items-author.json (h3) plus the 13 contracts in netzoo-core-p0-run/workflows/*.yaml and scripts/workflow_registry.py (ACTION_DEFINITIONS, WORKFLOW_CONTROLS, input-inspection executor_fields, CLAIM_SUPPORT/UNSUPPORTED_CLAIMS, GUIDANCE_COMPOSITIONS). Nothing else was opened and the assistant was not run. Each prompt was checked against the quoted contract text: class, gold workflows (for do: none missing or extra), deciding fact or missing core. Limits were checked by arithmetic: LIONESS-DRAGON value counts use n(n-1)/2 feature pairs times samples (L09 550 features x 48 = 7,246,800; L13 2,500 x 120 = 374,850,000; L18 400 x 60 = 4,788,000 vs 1,600 x 60 = 76,752,000; including the diagonal changes no verdict). Also checked: SAMBAR 2 <= kmin <= kmax <= samples (L30 3<=9<=9; L39 kmax 8 vs 6 or 10), COBRA genes > samples (L31 18,500>240; L40 ~400 vs <350 against 380; L44 150<400), BONOBO delta with sparsify in (0, 1/3) (L15 0.3 ok; L28 0.5 out), DRAGON paired lambdas in [0,1] (L02 0 and 1 ok; L10 one manual and one estimated refused), OTTER controls (L03 lam max 1; L46 lam 0.9, gamma 0 at its minimum, iterations 150 >= 1, cpu/single), GIRAFFE has controls: [] (L21). file_checkable was set only for ask items with form run, using the yaml input_checks lists (whose header says they are 'what the input check verifies before a run') and the registry's inspection steps: L18 (20,000,000-value refusal 'before they start'), L39 (inspect_sambar_inputs reads mutation_file with kmin/kmax/cluster), L40 (inspect_cobra_inputs reads expression_file; genes > samples) are settled from the named files; L03's lam is a request setting no file check reads. No gold contradicts the contract text; borderline readings are flagged in the reasons.
